channel.description: Dayan Daniel Kada's in-depth Dayanut shiurim on Shulhan Arukh Even HaEzer, Hilchot Ishut: marriage, lineage, Kohanim, mamzerut, yibum and remarriage, seif by seif, 2023-25.

item.title: When Does Rabbenu Gershom's Ban Not Apply? | Even HaEzer, Ishut 1:10-14
item.description:
Dayan Kada studies Rabbenu Gershom's ban on a second wife through the Rishonim: its reasons, where and for how long it spread, the exceptions the Shulhan Arukh and the Rema list, the Meah Rabbanim release, and how Batei Din apply it today.

item.title: Must You Check a Family's Lineage Before a Wedding? | Even HaEzer, Ishut 2:1, 6-10 and 2-3 Part 1
item.description:

item.title: Intimacy With a Non-Jew: What Is Forbidden? | Even HaEzer, Ishut 16
item.description:
Dayan Kada sets out the three levels of the prohibition of relations with a non-Jewish woman (marriage, a regular partner, a one-off), the dispute whether it is from the Torah and applies to all nations, and what the Rambam and the Shulhan Arukh say about Kanaim Pogim Bo, a Kohen and a shifhah.
